headline: Dangote Sugar Swings to Profit with N78.17 Billion Pre-Tax Earnings in 9M
summary: Dangote Sugar Refinery recorded a profit before tax of N78.17 billion for the nine months ended September 30, rebounding from a pre-tax loss in the prior year.
why: Corporate earnings reports provide vital fundamental data for assessing a company's operational turnaround and profitability in frontier markets.

impacts.name: Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc
impacts.why: A strong swing back to pre-tax profitability indicates improved cost management or pricing power.
